CZ/SK Internal Document (interní / interný doklad)

Prints a journal entry as the internal accounting document — interní doklad in Czech, interný doklad in Slovak — with the particulars the accounting acts require.

Version19.0.1.0.1
EditionCommunity and Enterprise
LicenceAGPL-3
Requiresaccount

What it is for

Every accounting entry needs an accounting document behind it. For an invoice or a bank statement that is the external document itself; for an entry that has nothing external behind it — an accrual, depreciation, a revaluation, a closing entry, a manual correction — the accountant writes an internal document (interní doklad in Czech, interný doklad in Slovak).

Odoo has no such printout. This module adds one: any journal entry prints as an internal document carrying the particulars the law asks of an accounting document, with a line for each signature.

It depends only on Odoo's account and does not need the rest of the Czech/Slovak localization.

Legal background

  • Czech Republic. § 11 odst. 1 of the Accounting Act No. 563/1991 Sb. requires an accounting document (účetní doklad) to contain its designation, the content of the accounting case and its participants, the amount, the moment the document was prepared, the moment the case occurred if that differs, and the signature record of the person responsible for the case and of the person responsible for booking it.
  • Slovakia. § 10 ods. 1 of the Accounting Act No. 431/2002 Z. z. requires the same particulars except the second signature: only the signature record of the person responsible for the accounting case, and that only where the case is not verified by electronic data interchange or an internal control system (§ 32 ods. 3 písm. b) and c)).

The printout follows the Czech list, which is the longer one, so it satisfies both. On a Slovak document the second signature line is simply more than the law asks for.

How to print it

Open a journal entry (Accounting → Accounting → Journal Entries, or any invoice, bill or entry) and choose Print → Interní / interný doklad. You can also select several entries in the list and print them together; each gets its own page. The file is named after the document, e.g. Interní doklad - MISC-2026-10-0007.pdf.

There is nothing to set up.

What the document shows

On the printout (CZ / SK) Taken from
Označení dokladu / Označenie dokladu the entry number
Účetní jednotka / Účtovná jednotka the company, with its company registry number (IČO) when filled in
Deník / Denník the journal
Obsah účetního případu / Obsah účtovného prípadu the entry's Reference; if empty, its internal note; if that is empty too, the labels of its lines
Účastníci účetního případu / Účastníci účtovného prípadu the company, then every partner on the entry and its lines
Peněžní částka / Peňažná suma the entry total (sum of debits), in company currency
Datum vyhotovení / Dátum vyhotovenia the day the entry was created in Odoo
Datum uskutečnění účetního případu / Dátum uskutočnenia účtovného prípadu the accounting date
Lines account, label, partner, analytic distribution with shares (e.g. Warehouse (60 %)), Má dáti / Má dať, Dal, and totals
Signature records on the left the user who created the entry, as responsible for the accounting case; on the right whoever posted it, as responsible for booking it; each with a line to sign on

A draft entry prints with NEZAÚČTOVÁNO / NEZAÚČTOVANÉ (not booked) under the title, and without a name on the booking signature.

Language

The wording is the statute's own and is not translated: it follows the company's fiscal country. A Slovak company prints the Slovak terms; every other company prints the Czech ones. The user's language does not matter.

Limitations

  • Datum vyhotovení is the day the record was created in Odoo, not a date you choose. If the document was prepared on another day, the printout does not show it.
  • The person who posted the entry is read from the entry's history (the last change of status). If the entry was posted by the scheduled auto-posting, that is the user the automation runs as; if the history was deleted, the name stays empty.
  • The printed names are the Odoo users who created and posted the entry, not necessarily the persons your internal rules make responsible. The signature lines are for an actual signature; the module does not sign anything electronically.
  • Quantities and unit prices are not printed; the amount is the entry total.
  • Every entry can be printed this way, including invoices and bills, although they already have an external document.

Legislation referenced on this page

  • Zákon č. 431/2002 Z. z. o účtovníctve
